title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Lombardy and Lazio. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Deborah Aderenti
tribute: Deborah Aderenti was 39 years old and came from Polpenazze, in Lombardy. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Rome
tribute: She was 74 years old and came from Rome, in Lazio. She is in our thoughts.
